key_assumptions.source: LTM distributable earnings $2.61/sh per Q2 2026 supplemental (2026-Q2-BN-Supplemental.pdf)

Fee-related earnings grew 20% in Q2; trailing twelve month distributable earnings before realizations grew 7% per share. Base keeps 8% as a conservative path versus management 15%+ distributable earnings target.

open_questions: Live price moved from **$42.39** (July dive) to **$37.31**. Confirm the quote is a regular-session close, not a bad print.
Holdings already **hold**. Math now clears the 15% band. No agent capital decision.
Management targets 15%+ distributable-earnings growth. Base uses 8%. Raising base growth to 10% would be a human override.
thesis: Brookfield Corporation is a global alternative-asset manager and owner of real-asset platforms. **[Fact]** Clients pay management and performance fees on capital deployed into infrastructure, real estate, credit, and private equity. **[Fact]** Owner economics are measured as distributable earnings, not GAAP net income. **[Fact]** Fee-bearing capital was **$672 billion** at June 30, 2026; insurance assets were **$191 billion**. **[Fact]** Trailing twelve month distributable earnings were **$6.2 billion**, or **$2.61 per share**. **[Inference]** Realizations are lumpy, so the base case grows owner cash without assuming a heroic carry year.
why_market_wrong: There is **no dated Horizon Kinetics predictive attribute**. **[Inference]** The listed price (**$37.31** on 2026-09-17) sits far below Brookfield's own blended capital of **$66.64 per share** at June 30, 2026. GAAP marks on more than **$525 billion** of consolidated assets add noise. The combination with Brookfield Wealth Solutions is approved and expected to close this year, but that is a simplification path, not a known payoff date.
